verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex is a payroll product, so configuring multiple pay schedules is an applicable axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents setting up weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, or monthly schedules, or assigning different schedules to different teams. The 'Intelligent Pay Cycle' item covers flagging payroll issues, an adjacent feature that is not multi-schedule configuration, so it earns no credit.
